name: kUML
description: A model-oriented textual DSL built with Kotlin, covering UML, SysML v2, C4, and BPMN with desktop, web, command-line, and IDE integrations.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 使用Kotlin类型安全DSL的文本建模，支持 UML 2.x、SysML 2、C4、BPMN，并提供桌面、Web、命令行及IDE集成。强调自己不是PlantUML/Mermaid那种“文本画图工具”，而是“真正的模型+文本DSL”。
